findings: Fixed mappings are frozen and exact members are tracked separately from ORed bits; duplicate keys canonicalize without mutating caller arrays. Query labels deliberately allow false-negative observations when passed an unsafe preview mask.

Bit masks admit exactly integers0..255, with negative zero normalized. Deletion removes only an inserted key and returns a separate unsafe mask plus a freshly rebuilt state; clearing shared bits can miss B after removing A, whereas rebuilding leaves bits4and6. All returned nested authored states are frozen.

The fixed-state experiment enumerates all64 ordered uniform query pairs with replacement, so s set bits admit s squared pairs. The separate two-bit construction has four insertion pairs with accepted query counts1,4,4,1, totaling10/16; averaging occupancy then squaring gives9/16 and is not the same experiment.

The six tests compare all128 exact-member subsets to a separately constructed cell-array oracle, all256 masks to s squared, every inserted-key removal to reconstruction, and sixteen construction/query draws to a Set oracle. The mapping C=(4,4) and Z=(2,2) is explicit and internally consistent.
